name: Carlkin's lighthouse
slug: Carlkin's lighthouse in New Navel is his home and bookshop, where an abyss door opens onto a fight with tentacles and a wall of eyes.
description: Carlkin's lighthouse in New Navel is his home and bookshop. The party has been inside once or twice. The ground floor is crowded with crates, barrels, maps, books, porridge bowls, and papers, with a pile directly behind the door and a spiral staircase on the far wall. The weathered door can swing shut almost on its own.

log.summary: The party is inside the lighthouse again. The weathered door can swing shut almost on its own. Gerk opens his abyss door in the crowded ground-floor room, and the fight with the tentacles and the wall of eyes happens there.
notes: The party has been inside once or twice. The ground floor is crowded with crates, barrels, maps, books, porridge bowls, and papers, with a pile directly behind the door and a spiral staircase on the far wall.
The weathered door can swing shut almost on its own. Gerk opens his abyss door in this room, and the fight with the tentacles and the wall of eyes happens here.

log.summary: The ground room is the base of the lighthouse, about forty feet across, with a cobbled floor now broken open by Gerk's doorway. Carlkin's desk holds parchment and a well-used imported writing set. He is adding a standing rule against portals on the premises and plans to repair the floor with Mending. The shop's bangles carry a residual detect magic. He receives people among clutter, good china, doilies, and a silver platter, and prefers appointments.
